The '''TrailMaker III''' was a powerful [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] during the early portion of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The TrailMaker, which came in both a military and civilian version and employed a giant [[TurboToo]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]], was the chief market competition for both of [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company's]] popular military bikes, the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] and the [[Yellow Demon 100 speeder bike|Yellow Demon 100]]. However, because of the TrailMaker's larger size and noisier operation compared to the 74-Z, the bike did not gain widespread acceptance among [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]].
